title: Receipt
description: The signed record correlating a Decision to what actually happened.

attempted.description: Whether execution was attempted after the Decision.

completed_at.description: When the outcome was recorded (Unix seconds).

signer.description: Actor id of the enforcement or observation point.

kid.description: Optional key identifier for ES256 signatures: the RFC 7638 JWK SHA-256 thumbprint (base64url, no padding) of the signing key, selected from the signer's published key set (Spec 07 §4.5). Outside the signed payload — a key-selection hint, not evidence.

execution_validation_ref.description: Optional id of the Execution Validation Record (Spec 30 §4, schemas/execution-validation-record.schema.json) that preceded this Receipt's dispatch, if the PEP performed that check. Not a kernel field — an optional Core-format correlation, absent when Execution-Time Authorization Validation (Spec 30) was not performed. As of signature_version 1.1 (Spec 07 §10.2), this field is inside the Receipt's signed payload; under 1.0 it was not — check signature_version before treating this correlation as cryptographically bound, not just present.
